style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun through glass
motion_rule: one clear action per window, only one of them moves at a time; the camera never carries a window alone, something in frame moves too; he never holds a pose, not even the last; the camera travels every window, no push in and no focus pull; new shot size every window; his antennae whip in speech too
character: a glossy red lobster, whipping antennae, ONE huge claw and one small, smug realtor
second_characters: ONE plump crab in a bow tie, never still; ONE cook behind the glass, only toque and hands in frame
props: ONE fish tank; ONE toy castle on the gravel; ONE tape measure and brass key; ONE pot on a lit stove, ONE lemon; ONE pair of steel tongs; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the pot steams harder every window; the castle breaks at 1.8 and loses a wall at 3.2
environment: inside a sunlit tank, gravel floor, a bright kitchen beyond the glass

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, smooth realtor patter, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ku-DA, vlo-ZHIT stress last, ne-DVI-zhi-most stress second, STU-di-yu stress first, u va-DY stress last, KUH-nyu, za-TO svoy, ne-na-DOL-ga stress third
audio.pacing: not a word before 0.9; 0.9-2.7 one breath; one pause, 2.7-3.2; 3.2-7.2 one breath; after 7.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable, not a voice over
audio.sfx: glass taps, claw snaps, a lid clanging, a rolling boil, a splash

timeline.a: the crab whips the tape measure round his tail, it clangs on the glass
he kicks the castle door open and scuttles out over the gravel
he blasts off the gravel and swings up the castle wall, gravel ripping past the lens
he swings the big claw through the castle, the turret snaps off at the lens
no words, he is out of frame. The cook slams the lid down, flame flaring up the glass
timeline.c: whip sideways along the glass to the stove

timeline.a: he rams the big claw through the castle wall, it caves in, gravel blasting at the lens
he taps the glass twice, water sloshing above him
the cook rips the lid off and a wall of steam blasts up the glass
timeline.c: over him, whip to the pot

timeline.a: he vaults onto the castle roof, gravel blasting off it
he scuttles at the camera till his face fills the frame
timeline.c: charge in with him to big close

timeline.a: no words. The steel tongs punch through the surface and the water bucks
timeline.c: wide, whip up to the tongs

timeline.a: the crab slams the castle door at the lens, the key clanging on it
timeline.c: macro at the door, whip off

timeline.a: the tongs grip his tail and haul him out, spray blasting off
he winks as the tongs swing him over the pot, the lemon drops in first

must_appear: the turret snapping off at 1.8, the wall caving in at 3.2, the cook ripping the lid off the pot at 4.75, the tongs hauling him out at 8.6, him winking over the pot at 9.3
negative_prompt: night, low key, a still camera, a slow push in, a focus pull, a camera move with nothing moving in frame, anyone holding the mic, a second lobster, more crabs, two actions at once, slow motion, any word after 7.2, silence in the tail, accented Russian, letters, cyrillic, subtitles, a glowing emblem, a logo, watermark, English speech, black bands
